data.body: [P2] Allow successful delivery on the first request. The scenario does not guarantee that `/recall` reaches the endpoint inside the approximately five-second settling window: `sendJob` first awaits CreateMicrovmAuthToken, which can outlast that window. The first POST can therefore correctly auto-resume the MicroVM and receive 202, yet these assertions fail the default end-to-end suite. Accept first-request success while retaining the memory and resume-hook assertions; require retry coverage in the composed tests with their controlled settling window.
